links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses on hypothyroidism (FRE, FKGL, GFI, SMOG)
links.effect: All models' outputs were relatively difficult to comprehend (low FRE, high FKGL/GFI scores), generally requiring college-level or higher education.
links.quote: The content generated by all models was relatively difficult to comprehend (low FRE scores and high FKGL/GFI scores), generally requiring a college-level or higher education for adequate understanding.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, DISCERN quality, and readability of responses generated by three LLMs (ChatGPT-3.5, DeepSeek-V3, Gemini-2.5) to clinical questions about hypothyroidism for potential patient education, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
